hints: The heights range from 158 cm to 196 cm, so use stems 15, 16, 17, 18, 19.
Anvils leaves go on the left, ordered outwards (right-to-left) in ascending order.
Brecons leaves go on the right, ordered outwards (left-to-right) in ascending order. Include a two-sided key.
walkthrough:
Construct the back-to-back stem-and-leaf diagram with Anvils leaves ordered outwards to the left and Brecons leaves ordered outwards to the right:
$$\begin{array}{r|c|l} \text{Anvils} & \text{Stem} & \text{Brecons} \\ \hline 8 & 15 & \\ 9 \; 5 & 16 & 6 \\ 5 \; 3 \; 2 \; 0 & 17 & 0 \; 1 \; 2 \; 2 \; 8 \\ 4 \; 1 \; 0 & 18 & 1 \; 2 \; 3 \; 3 \\ 6 & 19 & 2 \end{array}$$

Provide a clear key for both sides:
$$\text{Key: } 5 \mid 16 \mid 6 \text{ means } 165\text{ cm for Anvils and } 166\text{ cm for Brecons}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Order each data set.
- Anvils ($11$ values): $158, 165, 169, 170, 172, 173, 175, 180, 181, 184, 196$
- Brecons ($11$ values): $166, 170, 171, 172, 172, 178, 181, 182, 183, 183, 192$

Step 2: Construct the central stem column.
The stems represent the tens and hundreds digits: $15, 16, 17, 18, 19$.

Step 3: Align leaves.
- Left side (Anvils): Leaves read outwards from the stem (smallest near the stem, largest furthest to the left).
- Right side (Brecons): Leaves read outwards from the stem (smallest near the stem, largest furthest to the right).
- Keep spacing even and columns aligned vertically.

Step 4: Write the key.

hints: For $n = 11$ ordered Anvils values, the median is the $\frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6$th value.
The lower quartile $Q_1$ is the 3rd value and the upper quartile $Q_3$ is the 9th value.
Calculate the interquartile range as $\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1$.
walkthrough:
Find the median ($Q_2$):
$$\text{Position of median} = \frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6\text{th value} \implies \text{Median} = 173\text{ cm}$$

Find the lower quartile ($Q_1$) and upper quartile ($Q_3$):
$$\text{Position of } Q_1 = \frac{11 + 1}{4} = 3\text{rd value} \implies Q_1 = 169\text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Position of } Q_3 = \frac{3(11 + 1)}{4} = 9\text{th value} \implies Q_3 = 181\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 181 - 169 = 12\text{ cm}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Write down the ordered data for Anvils:
$$158, 165, 169, 170, 172, 173, 175, 180, 181, 184, 196 \quad (n = 11)$$

Step 2: Find the median:
$$\text{Rank} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{12}{2} = 6\text{th value} \implies \text{Median} = 173\text{ cm}$$

Step 3: Find the lower quartile $Q_1$:
$$\text{Rank} = \frac{n + 1}{4} = \frac{12}{4} = 3\text{rd value} \implies Q_1 = 169\text{ cm}$$

Step 4: Find the upper quartile $Q_3$:
$$\text{Rank} = \frac{3(n + 1)}{4} = \frac{36}{4} = 9\text{th value} \implies Q_3 = 181\text{ cm}$$

Step 5: Compute the interquartile range:
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 181 - 169 = 12\text{ cm}$$

hints: Add the 3 new heights (166, 172, 182) to the original $\sum x = 1923$ to find the new sum for $n = 14$ people.
Add the squares $166^2 + 172^2 + 182^2$ to the original $\sum x^2 = 337\,221$ to find the new $\sum x^2$.
Use $\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\sum x^2}{14} - \left(\frac{\sum x}{14}\right)^2}$ to find the standard deviation.
walkthrough:
Calculate the variance and standard deviation:
$$\operatorname{Var}(x) = \frac{427\,485}{14} - (174.5)^2 = 30\,534.64286 - 30\,450.25 = 84.39286$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{84.39286} \approx 9.18656 \approx 9.19\text{ cm}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Update the summary statistics.
Original group: $11$ members with $\sum x = 1923$ and $\sum x^2 = 337\,221$.
Three new members join with heights $166, 172,$ and $182$ cm.
New sample size: $n = 11 + 3 = 14$.

New $\sum x$:
$$\sum x = 1923 + 166 + 172 + 182 = 2443$$

New $\sum x^2$:
$$\sum x^2 = 337\,221 + 166^2 + 172^2 + 182^2$$
$$= 337\,221 + 27\,556 + 29\,584 + 33\,124 = 427\,485$$

Step 2: Calculate the mean:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} = \frac{2443}{14} = 174.5$$

Step 3: Calculate the variance:
$$\sigma^2 = \frac{\sum x^2}{n} - (\bar{x})^2$$
$$= \frac{427\,485}{14} - (174.5)^2$$
$$= 30\,534.64286 - 30\,450.25 = 84.39286$$

Step 4: Calculate the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{84.39286} \approx 9.18656 \approx 9.19\text{ cm}$$
